layers.name: Omega foundation gates
layers.note: Gates 1 through 14 closed with one combined admission receipt: 230 checks, 0 failures.

layers.name: Turing instrument
layers.note: Implemented (instrument); science partial. Current level: L2, Brownian scope only, instrument certification. L2 verdicts were checked against the private sealed records on 2026-10-01; the records stay private. Outside Brownian scope the ceiling is L1. TY-2 recorded 2,559,679.825 bits of Turing gain. This is a gain in bits, not a yield. Yield is T/J (Turings per joule), and T/J is not established: no energy was measured.

layers.name: Native C kernel
layers.note: Freestanding C kernel on main. Boots via UEFI in emulation, with NVMe, ARGUS capability checks, and the sealed Store in the boot path.

layers.name: Native machine qualification (M5)
layers.note: First qualification receipt: NOT QUALIFIED, 10 blocked, 6 missing. Published, and being worked down in public.

layers.name: Turing experiments (EXP-001 / 002 / 003)
layers.note: EXP-001 FAIL, EXP-001R PASS, EXP-002A PASS, EXP-002B PASS, EXP-002C PASS, EXP-002D INCOMPLETE, EXP-003 BLOCKED. Failures stay on the record.

layers.name: AIEN, the persistent agent
layers.note: Runs in the lab on the DGX Spark. The learning loop, learning from verified experience, is the active build.

layers.name: Atlas, the awakening layer
layers.note: The seed that wakes AienOS on new hardware. Doctrine published in the architecture repository; implementation ahead.

layers.name: Public release
layers.note: Pre-alpha. No supported release or installer yet. When there is one, it ships with versions, hashes, and signatures, inspectable before it runs.
